svg.title: Local development topology
svg.desc: The browser reaches the API through the Vite proxy. PostgreSQL persists workspace data. Ports 3000 and 8080 are development defaults; no cloud deployment is asserted.

svg.title: Pay Period Planner local development topology
svg.desc: The browser loads React from Vite. Vite proxies API requests to Spring Boot, which uses PostgreSQL. This is local development, not deployed cloud infrastructure.

svg.text: Ports 3000 and 8080 are development defaults; no cloud deployment is asserted.
